tasks.task: Map product data to a marketplace's own fields

items.when: When the brand's product data must fit eBay, Walmart, bol or Zalando fields, with gaps shown
When you need a column-by-column map from the store export to the marketplace file, with rules
When it is unclear what is one product with variants and what are separate listings
Before mapping, to find blanks, duplicates and odd values in the source product data

tasks.task: Write eBay or Walmart listings for a batch of products

items.when: Before writing, to know each marketplace's required fields, title length and banned wording
When you have product facts and need a title, bullets and description built for the marketplace
When you want to see how top rival listings word titles and price the same item
When a description could fit any seller, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite
When the listings are drafted, to catch missing details before they are uploaded
When a listing leans on praise words and needs facts a buyer can check
Before the batch is uploaded, to trace each size, material, price and delivery line to the product data

tasks.task: Fill and check a bulk upload sheet

items.when: When each row must carry every required field in the marketplace's own format
When you need a clean empty sheet from a confirmed field list, with no invented rows
When source titles are inconsistent and need tidying before they go in the sheet
When the sheet keeps failing upload and must be fixed and re-checked until it passes
Before upload, to find items sharing a code or barcode that would mix stock across channels

tasks.task: Check listing health and rank the fixes

items.when: When a listing export shows errors, low quality scores or missing details
When hundreds of listings miss fields and you need the gaps grouped by cause

tasks.task: Get product photos ready for marketplace rules

items.when: When photos are not taken yet and the seller needs a shot list with a reason for each
When a whole sheet of products needs one matching photo each, with faults reported
When a clothing seller has only phone flat lays and needs clean, rule-safe photos
When one real product needs a fuller set of angles to choose from, checked frame by frame
Before upload, to get a pass or fail and one fix for each photo; it does not cover each platform's own rules

tasks.task: Work out what the seller keeps on each channel

items.when: Before comparing channels, reconcile supplied shipping, packaging, return and fee assumptions
Before listing on a new marketplace or app, or when payouts feel thin
When you need profit per item on each channel, on the fee base each one really uses
When one item's price is in doubt and you need its true margin from price and every cost
When you want a quick hand check of one typical order against the full sheet
Before the sheet goes to the seller, to test the method and the sums
When fees are stacked and you must trace each one to see what reaches the seller

tasks.task: Build a landed cost and margin sheet for a new country

items.when: When you have a quote and freight and need cost per sellable unit and margin
When freight and duty invoices must be spread across products to get true cost per unit
When you need tariff codes, duty options and the papers customs will ask for
When landed cost is known and you must see what is left after the marketplace's fees

tasks.task: Plan entry to a new marketplace or country

items.when: When the client wants to sell on a new marketplace or in a new country
When you need the entry plan: account, tax, product rules, delivery, returns and costs
When the client has not chosen a country, to rank options with shipping and tax costs
When you want a second view of market pick, entry route and what to localise
When the target is Amazon, Shopee, Temu or TikTok Shop abroad and needs margin and a launch order
When sales by country may justify local stock and you need the trigger for each step

tasks.task: Check seller readiness: identity, tax and product safety

items.when: Before joining a marketplace, or when it asks for identity, product safety or tax details
When you need the rules that apply to what the seller makes, imports and exports, with owners
When goods will cross a border and the customs papers must be ready first

tasks.task: Localise listings for another country

items.when: When a title or key line should be tried in two or three natural local wordings
When you have the original and translated text side by side and need a meaning check
When the local marketplace has its own required fields the home listing never needed
Before the listings go live, to confirm price, currency, stock and link work for a buyer in that country

tasks.task: Write a China marketplace operating plan

items.when: When the brand will sell on Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo or Douyin and needs margin checks and a plan
Before the plan, to turn China trend data into platform picks and a week-by-week brief
When the plan must be tested for costs and rules the brand has not met before

tasks.task: Write buyer message templates by marketplace and issue

items.when: Before writing, to know what each marketplace allows and bans in buyer messages
When the seller wants a set of reply templates and a routine that drafts first replies
When one buyer situation needs a reply in the right tone with notes on what to check
When a buyer writes in another language and needs a reply in it
When templates are polite but make the buyer do more work to get the problem solved

tasks.task: Respond to a buyer case, claim or return request

items.when: When a buyer opens a case and you need a response with evidence before the deadline
When you must decide whether to refund, replace or contest inside the marketplace's rules
When the case is a late, lost or damaged parcel and a carrier claim is needed too
Before sending, to check every date, tracking event and statement can be traced to a record

tasks.task: Reply to upset buyers before they open a case

items.when: When the inbox is full and messages must be ranked, with a draft reply for each
When you need to spot which messages are close to a case or bad feedback
When a buyer is angry and the reply must fix what it can and promise nothing false
Before a hard reply is sent, to check its promises, facts and tone

tasks.task: Follow up feedback and reviews within policy

items.when: Before any feedback request, to know what the marketplace allows you to ask and offer
When the seller needs a fair time and wording to ask for feedback
When a batch of reviews needs a specific public reply each
When replies run every week and risky ones must be held for the seller

tasks.task: Write an account health watch report from exports

items.when: When you have the performance exports and need each rate set against the marketplace's limit
When cancellations are rising and you need the rate over time and the reasons
Each month, to name the items behind returns and the one fix to make first
When the watch report must rerun each week from the same exports

tasks.task: Respond to a warning, suppression or suspension

items.when: When a marketplace warns, suppresses listings, limits selling, holds funds or suspends
When the marketplace allows an appeal or asks for a plan of action
Before the appeal is sent, to check each fact, date and fix is true and can be shown

tasks.task: Run weekly marketplace operations

items.when: For the daily inbox and case check, the Monday review and the monthly fee and price check
Each morning, to find late and stuck orders before buyers write or a late rate rises
When stock counts across channels look wrong and an oversell is likely
When the seller wants one page on what was done, what is stuck and what is needed

tasks.task: Set and adjust prices across channels

items.when: When you have costs and rival offers and need a price per product and rules for rival discounts
When you want a second price view from costs, rival prices and buyer value, with a margin table
When prices will move by rule and you need safe limits, test cases and a stop switch
When a price change is live and someone must watch it and call keep or undo
Before any price change, to see what is left on that channel after its fees

tasks.task: Plan promotions with a margin check on each

items.when: When you want promotion ideas beyond a plain price cut, such as a gift or bundle
Before a promotion, to find the deepest discount the margin allows and the wording to use
When the marketplace or app takes its fee on the full price and the promotion cost is yours

tasks.task: Rebuild a menu for delivery apps

items.when: When a dine-in menu must be fitted to an app's categories, options and item fields
When category and item names are drafted, to rate each and rewrite the unclear ones
When item descriptions are vague, to make each short, true and easy to picture
When the kitchen needs a photo shot list for its best sellers

tasks.task: Price delivery items after app commission

items.when: When you need what is left on each item after commission, packaging and promotions
When a dish has no costing and you need cost per portion from real weights first
When each app charges on a different base and the same dish earns different amounts

tasks.task: Set returns rules that fit each marketplace

items.when: When you need each marketplace's own return window and who pays, before writing any rule
When you have returns data and costs and need refund timing and keep-it rules
When the policy text is drafted, to find gaps, clashes and unclear wording

tasks.task: Choose how orders will be fulfilled on a new channel

items.when: When the seller needs a fulfilment partner and a request for pricing with terms to ask for
When the marketplace sets delivery promises the seller must be able to meet
When parcels go late or missing and each needs next steps and a carrier claim

always.when: Before any listing goes live, to sort each claim as fine, needs proof or cut
Before any listing, reply or appeal is sent, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When the job includes Amazon, which has its own listing, fee and account rules
When listings or buyer replies need a careful translation, not a quick local version
When carriers, customs papers or a fulfilment partner must be set up and run
When buyer messages are high in volume and need a full support routine
When product safety, labelling or tax registration needs more than a readiness check
When a delivery menu depends on kitchen costs, prep times and what the kitchen can make

gaps: No library item knows eBay or Walmart listing rules: item specifics, category attributes, title limits and condition grades
No library item covers bol, Zalando or other European marketplaces at all
No library item fills a marketplace's own bulk upload template or reads its upload error report
No library item works out marketplace fees on each one's real fee base; only the kit skill and prompt cover it
No library item covers VAT, import one-stop shop, duty-paid delivery or sales tax for cross-border sellers
No library item drafts a marketplace appeal or plan of action with root cause, fix and prevention; only the kit prompt covers it
No library item builds the evidence list for a marketplace case such as item not received or not as described
No library item reads marketplace account health exports: defect, late shipment and cancellation rates against limits
No library item rebuilds a menu for delivery apps: categories, options, item names, descriptions and photos
No library item plans marketplace ads such as eBay promoted listings or Walmart sponsored products
No library item gives two or three listing title patterns per marketplace to compare before a batch is written
No library item keeps stock in step across several marketplaces or sets buffer stock to stop overselling
No library item writes listings for used or refurbished goods with condition notes
No English library item checks photos against each marketplace's image rules or localises a listing's sizes, units and labels; those that exist are written in Chinese
